command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

cat > sumcheck.wdl <<'WDLEOF'
task partial {
  Int lo
  Int hi
  command <<<
    seq ${lo} ${hi} | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
  >>>
  output {
    Int sum = read_int(stdout())
  }
  runtime { }
}

task gather {
  Array[Int] parts
  command <<<
    echo "${sep=' ' parts}" | tr ' ' '\n' | awk 'NF{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
  >>>
  output {
    Int total = read_int(stdout())
  }
}

workflow sumcheck {
  Int n = 1000
  Int shards = 8
  Int per = n / shards
  scatter (i in range(shards)) {
    call partial { input: lo = i*per + 1, hi = (i+1)*per }
  }
  call gather { input: parts = partial.sum }
  output {
    Int total = gather.total
  }
}
WDLEOF

echo "== static validation (womtool) =="
womtool validate sumcheck.wdl > womtool.txt 2>&1
cat womtool.txt

echo "== run the workflow (Cromwell local backend) =="
cromwell run sumcheck.wdl -m meta.json > run.log 2>&1 || { echo CROMWELL_FAIL; grep -iE "Unrecognized|input processing failed|error" run.log | head -5; exit 1; }

# Cromwell prints the outputs block TWICE; take the first match only.
# `exit` is safe here because awk reads a FILE (no upstream writer to SIGPIPE, unlike `| head`).
TOTAL=$(awk -F': *' '/"sumcheck.total"/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$2); print $2; exit}' run.log)
SHARDS=$(ls -d cromwell-executions/sumcheck/*/call-partial/shard-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")
for f in cromwell-executions/sumcheck/*/call-partial/shard-*/execution/stdout; do cat "$f"; done | sort -n > got_partials.txt
awk 'BEGIN{n=1000;s=8;per=n/s; for(i=0;i<s;i++){lo=i*per+1;hi=(i+1)*per; print (hi*(hi+1)-(lo-1)*lo)/2}}' | sort -n > want_partials.txt
PARTIALS_OK=no; cmp -s got_partials.txt want_partials.txt && PARTIALS_OK=yes
EXPECT=$(awk 'BEGIN{n=1000; print n*(n+1)/2}')
CROMVER=$(awk 'NR==1{print $NF}' womtool.txt 2>/dev/null)

{
  echo "Cromwell/WDL -- scatter-gather verified against a closed-form identity"
  echo "cromwell_version    0.40"
  echo "womtool_validate    $(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' womtool.txt)"
  echo "shards_materialised $SHARDS   (assert 8 -- the scatter really fanned out)"
  echo "per_shard_partials  $(tr '\n' ' ' < got_partials.txt)"
  echo "expected_partials   $(tr '\n' ' ' < want_partials.txt)"
  echo "partials_identical  $PARTIALS_OK   (assert yes -- each shard got the RIGHT range, which a correct total alone would not prove)"
  echo "gathered_total      $TOTAL   (assert $EXPECT = n(n+1)/2, EXACT)"
  echo "note  WDL command blocks use <<< >>> heredocs: awk braces collide with command { } brace matching"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$SHARDS" -eq 8
test "$PARTIALS_OK" = yes
test "$TOTAL" -eq "$EXPECT"
grep -q Success womtool.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
